assignments.value:
Hi {{ $json.firstName }},

I was reviewing the interim leadership market today and your profile stood out—specifically your background in {{ $json.headline || 'LTC nursing leadership' }}.

I'm Lynn Fossen, R.N., and I co-own NextLTC. We are a specialized firm connecting facilities with interim leadership support. Unlike the generalist agencies, we are nurse-owned and understand the specific reality of the DON role (especially during these chaotic survey windows!).

We are currently seeing a surge in demand for travel leaders with your specific regulatory skillset. Are you currently on assignment, or would you be open to a brief chat about what you're looking for in your next contract?

Best,
Lynn Fossen, R.N.
Co-owner, NextLTC

assignments.value: Question from a fellow RN / Leadership transitions

assignments.name: emailBody
assignments.value:
Hi {{ $json.firstName }},

I hope you're having a manageable week at {{ $json.company || 'your facility' }}.

I'm reaching out because I see you've been navigating the DON role for a while now. I'm Lynn Fossen, R.N., with NextLTC.

I know how demanding the permanent Director role has become, especially with the recent flux in CMS staffing mandates. Many of the leaders in my network are transitioning to interim/travel contracts to regain some flexibility and work-life balance while staying in leadership.

I'm not sure if that's a path you've ever considered, but given your tenure, your experience would be highly valued. If you're ever curious about what the interim lifestyle looks like—or just need a change of pace—I'd love to connect.

No pressure at all, just wanted to say hello.

Take care,
Lynn Fossen, R.N.

assignments.name: emailBody
assignments.value:
Hi {{ $json.firstName }},

I'm writing to you as a fellow RN in the LTC space. I run a consulting firm (NextLTC) and I'm currently looking for a strong Interim DON for a contract that requires deep expertise.

Given your standing in the nursing community, I wondered if you might know any excellent leaders who are currently looking for travel assignments?

Or, if you happen to be wrapping up a contract yourself, I'd certainly love to speak with you.

Thanks for any direction you can point me in.

Best,
Lynn Fossen, R.N.
